document_rule: Retain both original PDFs and every one of the 1360 upstream corpus pages; no document reduction.
freeze_rule: Do not change selected identities after observing any extraction or retrieval result. Subsequent repairs on this inspected panel are regression feedback rather than fresh held-out evidence.
input_rule: Use only public official pinned HF artifacts and viewer responses whose x-revision equals immutable revision. Do not download corpus image Parquet shards or use supplied OCR markdown for indexing or scoring. Stop on access denial; rate limits only bounded retry.
interpretation: 48 independent English questions, 96 English/Portuguese texts. Cluster comparisons by translation pair. Same-domain textbook questions are not independent document samples; only two PDFs. This is an adapted local retrieval panel, not official ViDoRe leaderboard evaluation.
pairing_rule: Pair English and Portuguese blocks by query_id-sorted ordinal. Require equal nonzero language counts, retained raw_answers equality, and identical complete qrels including page IDs, grades, content types and bounding boxes except query_id. Fail on any mismatch.
qrel_rule: Retain every upstream positive page judgment for every selected query. Normalize positive-area pixel rectangles by viewer image dimensions; retain zero-area diagnostics and all page labels. Fail for invalid nonzero coordinates or absent pages.
query_rule: Enumerate English originals by query_id. Rank by SHA256(UTF8(seed + NUL + dataset + NUL + English query ID)), ascending, then integer ID as tie-break. Take first 48. Keep the corresponding Portuguese translation for each.
source_choice_rationale: Official independent textbook domain; same ViDoRe original PDF, graded page-qrel and human rectangle schema; exactly two PDFs allow the complete corpus within ~65 MB.
